AGENDA
la puente City Council and Successor Agency Regular Meeting
COUNCIL CHAMBERS
15900 EAST MAIN STREET, LA PUENTE
MAY 14, 2013
06:30
P.M.
6:30 P.M. CLOSED SESSION AGENDA
CALL TO ORDER
ROLL CALL
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS -- CLOSED SESSION
At this time, only item(s) on the Closed Session agenda may be discussed in Public Comments.
THE CITY COUNCIL WILL RECESS TO CLOSED SESSION, CONFERENCE WITH LEGAL COUNSEL - ANTICIPATED LITIGATION, Initiation of litigation pursuant to Government Code Section 54956.9(c) (Two cases)
RECESS INTO CLOSED SESSION:
RECONVENE TO OPEN SESSION
REPORT OUT OF CLOSED SESSION
7:00 P.M. OPEN SESSION AGENDA
ROLL CALL
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
PRESENTATIONS
CERTIFICATE OF APPRECIATION TO CAPTAIN MIKE CLAUS OF THE LOS ANGELES SHERIFF'S DEPARTMENT
PRESENTATION OF MILITARY BANNER CERTIFICATE
PRESENTATION FROM SOUTHLAND TRANSIT
LA PUENTE PROPOSAL PRESENTATION -5 14 2013
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
If you wish to address the City Council on an item other than a closed session and public hearing matter, please complete the Request for Oral Presentation form and submit it to the City Clerk no later than prior to the conclusion of the first speaker's remarks. (Ordinance No. 06-843).
BOARDS/COMMISSION/COMMITTEE REPORTS
A.
MINUTES OF PREVIOUS CITY COUNCIL AND SUCCESSOR AGENCY
A-1
READ AND APPROVE THE MINUTES OF THE REGULAR AND SPECIAL MEETINGS OF APRIL 9, 2013 AND REGULAR MEETING OF APRIL 23, 2013
A-1 04-09-13 CC-SA Minutes Reg & Spc
A-1 04-23-13 CC Minutes
B.
PUBLIC HEARINGS BEFORE THE CITY COUNCIL - None.
C.
UNFINISHED BUSINESS OF THE CITY COUNCIL - None.
D.
CITY COUNCIL CONSENT CALENDAR
All matters listed under Consent Calendar are considered to be routine in nature and may be enacted by one motion approving the recommendation listed on the Agenda. One or more items may be removed from the Consent Calendar so that said item(s) may be discussed and considered individually by the City Council, if a motion to remove the item(s) is approved by an affirmative vote of a majority of the members of the City Council. Those specific item(s) will be considered as the first item under New Business.
D-1
CONSIDERATION OF A RESOLUTION APPROVING WARRANT REGISTER NO. 1340 FISCAL YEAR 2012-2013
The City Council adopted Resolution No. 0.-5073 approving Warrant Register Nos. 1340.
D-1 Warrant Register #1340
D-2
CONSIDERATION OF AN AGREEMENT BETWEEN THE CITY AND LOS ANGELES COUNTY FOR THE COUNTYWIDE HOUSEHOLD HAZARDOUS WASTE COLLECTION EVENT
The City Council approved the Countywide Household Hazardous Waste Collection Program Siting Liability Agreement No. 13-1110 and authorized the Mayor to sign the agreement.
D-2 Staff Report - Hazardous Waste Collection Event
D-2 County Household Hazardous Waste Round-up Agreement -2013
D-3
CONSIDERATION OF A RESOLUTION APPROVING A SUBORDINATION AGREEMENT BETWEEN THE CITY OF LA PUENTE, ARMANDO ROLDAN, AND BANK OF AMERICA, WITH RESPECT TO THE CALHOME LOAN PROGRAM
The City Council: 1) Adopted Resolution No. 13-5074 approving the new Subordination Agreement No. 13-1111; and 2) Authorized the City Manager to execute the Subordination Agreement on behalf of the City.
D-3 Staff Report Subordination Agreement Roldan
D-3 Resolution_Subordination Agreement_Roldan
D-3 Subordination Agreement-Roldan
D-4
CONSIDERATION OF AN AMENDMENT TO A PROFESSIONAL SERVICES AGREEMENT WITH INTELLIBRIDGE PARTNERS, LLC TO PROVIDE INTERIM ADMINISTRATIVE SERVICES DIRECTOR SERVICES IN AN AMOUNT NOT TO EXCEED $15,000.00
The City Council approved Amendment No. 13-1105-01 to the Professional Services Agreement with IntelliBridge Partners, LLC in the amount of $15,000.00.
D-4 Staff Report Amendment Interim Administrative Services Director PSA
D-4 Attachment A - Amendment to IntelliBridge Agreement - Interim Administrative Services Director
D-4 Agreement No. 13-1105 Intellibridge-Interim Dir. Adm. Srvcs - Exhibit 1
D-5
CONSIDERATION OF SCHOLARSHIP AWARDS FOR FY 2013-2014
Staff Recommendation: It is recommended by the Education Commission that the City Council 1) Award fifteen scholarships for the 2013-2014 academic year in the amount of $500 each; 2) Authorize the Finance Manager to create a scholarship fund and place $4,000 for use in FY 2014-2015; and 3) Schedule a presentation of awards during the May 28, 2013 City Council Meeting.
D-5 Scholarship Awards FY 2012-13
D-5 Scholarship Awards FY 2012-13 - Attach A
D-6
CONSIDERATION OF AN AGREEMENT WITH PUBLIC FINANCIAL MANAGEMENT, INC. FOR FINANCIAL ADVISORY SERVICES IN AN AMOUNT NOT TO EXCEED $24,500
The City Council approved Agreement No. 13-1112 with Public Financial Management, Inc. for financial advisory services, in an amount not to exceed $24,500.00.
D-6 La Puente Staff Report on PFM agreement
D-6 REVISED PSA Public Financial Management - A
E.
NEW BUSINESS TO BE CONSIDERED BY THE CITY COUNCIL
THIS ITEM WAS TAKEN OUT OF ORDER
E-2
DISCUSSION AND DIRECTION ON CODE ENFORCEMENT (Mayor Klinakis)
E-1
CONSIDERATION OF MAYOR'S APPOINTMENTS TO VARIOUS BOARD POSITIONS
E-1 Mayor Appointments Report
E-1 Mayor Appointments Attach A
E-1 Mayor Appointments Attach B
E-1 Mayor Appointments Resolution Attach C
E-3
FISCAL YEAR 2012/2013 BUDGET WORKSHOP
Staff Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council receive and file this report.
E-3 Fiscal Year 2103-2014 Budget
FY13-14 Budget Workshop Council Presentation - May 14, 2013
E-4
CONSIDERATION OF A RECOMMENDATION SEEKING COUNCIL APPROVAL TO PAY OFF THE CITY'S SIDE FUND LIABILITY TO CALPERS
Staff Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council approve the payoff of the side fund liability to CalPERS in the amount of $282,271.00, using unassigned General Fund reserves.
E-4 La Puente Staff Report on CALPERS Sidefund
E-4 La Puente Staff Report on CALPERS Sidefund Attach A
E-4 La Puente Staff Report on CALPERS Sidefund Attach B
E-4 La Puente Staff Report on CALPERS Sidefund Attach C
ADHOC COMMITTEE REPORTS - None.
AB 1234 REPORTS - None.
ORAL COMMENTS FROM COUNCIL
ORAL COMMENTS FROM STAFF - None.
ADJOURNMENT
05-14-13 CC Minutes Reg- signed
AVAILABILITY
Any writings or documents provided to a majority of the City Council/Successor Agency regarding any item on this agenda will be made available for public inspection during normal business hours at City Hall located at 15900 E. Main Street, the La Puente Community Center located at 501 North Glendora and the Los Angeles County Library located at 15920 E. Central. In addition, such writings and documents will be posted on the City's website at http://www.lapuente.org.
AMERICANS WITH DISABILITIES
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, if you need special assistance to participate in a City meeting or other services offered by the City, please contact the City Clerk's Office at (626) 855-1500. Notification at least 48 hours prior to the meeting or time when services are needed will assist City staff in assuring that reasonable arrangements can be made to provide accessibility to the meeting or service.
MEETING TIMES
Meetings of the City Council shall be adjourned no later than 10:30 p.m., unless a motion to supersede the 10:30 time limit to consider some or all of the remaining items listed on the Agenda, or to consider items which have been added to the Agenda in accordance with the provisions of the Ralph M. Brown Act, Government Code Section 54950, et seq., is approved by a majority of the members of the City Council. (Ordinance No. 95-727).
CERTIFICATION
I hereby certify under penalty of perjury, under the laws of the State of California that the foregoing agenda was posted in accordance with the applicable legal requirements.
Dated this
___________________________________
Pat Jacquez-Nares, CMC, City Clerk
